summary: The admitted Archon gaze case reaches mhitm.c:gazemm, where JavaScript evaluates AD_BLND to identify the Archon's blind gaze. js/mhitm.js uses that symbol but does not import it from monsters.js, so every gaze dispatch throws ReferenceError before the source branch can run.

source.branch: mattackm dispatches an AT_GAZE attack to gazemm; gazemm checks whether the attacker is an Archon and the attack damage type is AD_BLND before applying Archon blindness and stun behavior.

evidence: The v73 C recording and saved admission evaluation identify an unhandled JavaScript exception, `AD_BLND is not defined`, on the Archon-versus-red-dragon case. The source-design recipe creates a tame Archon and hostile red dragon so an actual monster-versus-monster gaze reaches the attack path.

upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/mhitm.c:736-805 defines gazemm; lines 739-741 compare the attacker to PM_ARCHON and mattk->adtyp to AD_BLND, and lines 789-796 apply blindness and a random stun gate. nethack-c/upstream/src/mhitm.c:about 430 dispatches AT_GAZE to gazemm.

upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/monmove.c:2097 calls mattackm from m_move_aggress. The corresponding JavaScript path is js/monmove.js:m_move_aggress -> js/mhitm.js:mattackm -> gazemm. js/monsters.js exports AD_BLND, but the js/mhitm.js monsters.js import list omits it while gazemm references it at line 1423.
